'''Mekerel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] who worked for the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Aral tukor Viest]] and was in charge of slaving pens aboard her [[Aral tukor Viest's clearinghouse|clearinghouse]] until [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], when he was possibly killed during [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] mission to liberate the slaves.<ref name="Razor's Edge">''[[Razor's Edge]]''</ref>
